Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie will open the batting for Ireland. Mitchell Santner will begin with the new ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! New Zealand have done well with the bat and will be happy with the target they have set keeping in mind how tough this pitch is to bat on. Ireland will need their big guns to fire if they want to chase this down and keep the series alive. Can they do so? We will know soon. Stay tuned for the second essay.

Dane Cleaver the man of the moment says that it was nice to get the few out of the middle and to get a good score in the middle. Tells that he reviewed how he played in the last game and came out with better plans today. Says that luckily he has his family around and adds that they have got enough runs on the board. Mentions that the pitch is good to bat on and if they can bowl the right lengths, they will be alright here.

Andy Balbirnie will be a tad disappointed with their bowling performance. It was a tough call to bowl first on such a wicket, where chasing has been challenging in the past and we did witness that in the previous T20I as well. But Andy did make the brave decision that did not quite go in his favour. They failed to grab early wickets and did leak runs at the start. But they have finished on a strong note and will be happy with a target of 180 considering the position they were in at the beginning. Craig Young and Josh Little were the bowlers who grabbed two wickets each for Ireland. It is a tough task to chase this one down but certainly not an impossible one. Ireland have enough fire power to get over the lone and draw this series.

After being put in to bat first, the Kiwis got off to a blistering start! Finn Allen and Martin Guptill stitched a partnership of 44 runs with the former playing an aggressive role. Once Finn Allen departed, Dane Cleaver walked in to bat. He took his time to settle in but once he did he played some fine shots. He along with Glenn Phillips set the perfect tone of the innings for the Kiwis and controlled the middle phase. Phillips did perish but Cleaver continued his merry way and notched his maiden T20I fifty.

It's been another solid and firm display of batting from the Kiwis! The par score on this ground is around 150 and the visitors have managed to get set a target well above that. Although they could have got way more than that. Ireland have done well towards the end to keep it to 179.

Brilliant last delivery and just a single in the end. This is a yorker, around off. Cleaver only manages to dig it out to backward point and takes a single. 8 runs from the last over and New Zealand finish with 179/4 after 20 overs!
FOUR! This time he gets a boundary! A full delivery, outside off. Cleaver slices it over the gully region for a boundary.
Dot ball! Cleaver gets across to scoop it and Adair cleverly bowls it full and wider outside off. Cleaver tries to adjust his shot and opens the face of his blade but misses.
A slower bouncer on middle. Neesham only manages to pull it towards short fine leg. A single taken. Can New Zealand reach 180?
WIDE! Adair goes wider outside off again. It is too wide though and James Neesham leaves it. A wide called.
On a length and outside off. James Neesham gets across and swings across the line but misses.
A yorker on off. Cleaver digs it out to mid off for a single.
James Neesham makes his way out to the middle. Also, Mark Adair will bowl the final over of the innings.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Josh Little produces a spicy bouncer this time and gets rid of Daryl Mitchell! It is a sharp one on off. It is too quick for Mitchell as he looks to pull it. The ball goes off his glove and loops up high in the air towards the keeper. Tucker takes it safely and New Zealand lose their fourth.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Lands on a length, around off. Mitchell looks to cut it but misses.

FOUR! Now, a misfield allows a boundary! Little decides to go full on off. Mitchell drills it straight down the ground. Adair at long off runs to his right and almost reaches the ball. However, he fails to get down in time and the ball goes across the fence.
FOUR! Another short ball and Mitchell takes full advantage of this! Little bowls a short one on off. Mitchell gets into the position early and pulls it towards the square leg fence for a boundary.
Bangs it short, on off. Cleaver pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Cleaver starts another over on a positive note! This is full and outside off. Cleaver carves it away over backward point for a boundary.
Josh Little (3-0-18-1) comes back on!
Just a single to end the over! A full delivery on off. Cleaver hits it aerially towards long off. The ball falls short of the fielder there and a single is taken.
A slower full delivery, around off. Cleaver heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
So three dots after a six on the first ball! Young uses his short ball again, on middle. Cleaver gets low surprisingly and looks to pull it but misses.
Lands on a length, on off. Cleaver looks to reverse-scoop it but misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Cleaver looks to hit it through the line but misses.
SIX! Great start to the over for the Kiwis! Young bangs it short. It sits up at a nice height and Cleaver pulls it over the square leg fence for a maximum.
A slower short ball on middle. Cleaver tries to pull it. However, he gets the top edge of his blade and the ball falls short of the deep backward square leg. A single taken.
A yorker on off. Cleaver only manages to dig it out back to the bowler.
On a length, on leg. Cleaver tucks it towards the fine leg region and comes back for the second run.
Back of the hand slower delivery, on a length and on off. Daryl Mitchell looks to heave it away but gets the inside half of his blade. The ball goes to deep square leg and a single is taken.
A fullish delivery on middle. Cleaver works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! What a way to get to a maiden T20I half-century! A full delivery on the pads. Cleaver whips it off his pads and whips it well. The ball goes all the way over the square leg fence for a maximum.
Barry McCarthy (3-0-37-0) comes back into the attack.
A  yorker on off. Mitchell looks to power it away but only gets the bottom of his blade. The ball goes back to the bowler. 9 runs from the over! Can New Zealand reach 180 here?
FOUR! Top placement! A short delivery on middle. It is a slower delivery and Daryl Mitchell picks it. He pulls it nicely in the gap towards the backward square leg fence.
Adair sees Cleaver charging down the pitch and goes very full. Cleaver looks to slog it away but gets the inside edge to mid-wicket for a single.
Bangs it short, around leg. Cleaver looks to pul it but misses.
FOUR! Over the in-field and away for a boundary! On a length, around off. Cleaver makes room and slaps it over extra-cover for a boundary.
On the shorter side, around off. Cleaver looks to reverse scoop it but misses.

FOUR LEG BYES! A slower one, short and into the body. Daryl Mitchell looks to pull but he gets undone by the lack of pace. The ball hits his pads and runs away wide of Lorcan Tucker towards third man for a boundary.
Full again, around middle. Dane Cleaver looks to flick this one over mid-wicket but the ball goes off his leading edge and lands in the vacant cover region. A single taken!
On a length, around middle. Daryl Mitchell pushes it towards mid on and takes a single.
Short one, around middle and off. Daryl Mitchell looks to pull this but he misses.
Daryl Mitchell walks out at number 5.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Craig Young grabs his second wicket as he gets rid of the dangerous, Glenn Phillips! Much-needed wicket for the Irish! A length ball, attacking the stumps. Glenn Phillips makes room and swings his bat to go over mid-wicket but he misses it completely. The ball goes on to knock the middle stump over.
Leg bye! A slower ball, on a length, angling in. Dane Cleaver misses his heave and the ball rolls away towards cover off his pads. A leg bye taken!

Leg bye! Direct hit...but safe! Back of a length again, on the pads. Dane Cleaver misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls away towards short fine leg and the batters leave their crease for a single. Lorcan Tucker chases the ball, collects it and scores a direct hit at the striker's end but Glenn Phillips was well in.
Good running! Short one, down the leg side. Dane Cleaver flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.

Missed Stumping chance! An opportunity gone! Fuller ball, drifting in, down the leg side. Dane Cleaver once again shimmies down the pitch and misses his heave. Lorcan Tucker fails to grab the ball as it hits him on the pads and rolls away.
Back of a length, around middle. Dane Cleaver dances down the pitch and pushes it through cover for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Up and over! Much fuller now, wide of off. Dane Cleaver shuffles across and slices it over short third man for a boundary.
Shorter ball, around off. Dane Cleaver pushes it off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a brace. Two taken!
Back of a length, around middle. Dane Cleaver taps it towards cover and takes a single.
Tight single! Josh Little sticks to his length, and serves yet another short one, outside off. Glenn Phillips dabs it towards cover-point and scampers across to the other end.

Edged and just short! Back of a length, outside off. Glenn Phillips stands tall and looks to punch this away on the off side but the ball goes off the outside edge and it falls just short of Craig Young there.
SIX! KABOOM! Josh Little drops it short once again, around middle. Glenn Phillips clears his front leg and pulls it high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Back of a length, around middle. Dane Cleaver pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, short ball. Glenn Phillips taps it off the back foot towards cover. Single taken!
Josh Little is back on.
Slightly short, around middle. Glenn Phillips works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs for New Zealand! Too short, down the leg side. Glenn Phillips leaves it alone. Lorcan Tucker jumps to grab the ball, but it flicks his gloves and runs away behind him towards fine leg for a boundary. 100 up as well.
Slower ball, on a length, around middle and leg. Glenn Phillips tucks it towards deep square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Nicely done! Back of a length, outside off. Glenn Phillips gets on top of the bouncer and dabs it towards third man for a boundary.
Back of a length, on middle. Cleaver works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! WOW! What a shot! A length delivery on off. Dane Cleaver gets into the position to reverse-scoop it. Then he sees the length a bit short and just angles his blade away towards the off side. He manages to get enough blade and the ball goes all the way over the third man fence.
A fuller delivery on leg. Cleaver looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his pads but it is down the leg side.
Barry McCarthy is back on.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Short and wide off. Glenn Phillips slaps it over cover for a boundary.
On middle, full again. Glenn Phillips blocks it out.
Fuller and on the pads. Dane Cleaver flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Good stop! Another short ball, around middle and off. Dane Cleaver pulls it in the gap between deep square leg square leg and deep mid-wicket. Mark Adair runs to his left, and stops the ball, he realizes he is crossing the boundary and throws it to George Dockrell who runs in from deep mid-wicket. Only a single.
A slower one, short, around off. Dane Cleaver pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Quick single! A fuller ball, around off. Glenn Phillips pushes it towards mid off and scampers across to the other end.
Curtis Campher comes into the attack.
Much fuller on off. Glenn Phillips drives it to long off for a single. Good over from George Dockrell, just 4 from it.
Slower through the air and it comes in with the angle. Glenn Phillips defends it back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off. Cleaver cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Darted on the pads this time. Glenn Phillips works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Pushed quicker on middle. Glenn Phillips blocks it out.
A flatter delivery on middle. Cleaver drives it to long on for a single.
Glenn Phillips walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT! The dangerous Martin Guptill departs! He has not been able to get his timing right today and now holes out at deep. Craig Young serves a short delivery on off. Guptill tries to pull it. However, the ball hurries him a bit and the ball goes off the top part of his blade to fine leg. It goes aerially and Barry McCarthy there takes an easy catch. Big wicket this, Craig Young has been expensive so far but has done the job for his skipper here.
Commentary.Howout: c Barry McCarthy b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Full delivery on middle. Cleaver drives it to long on for a single.
Serves a length delivery on middle. Cleaver works it to mid-wicket.
A length delivery, around off. Cleaver lunges forward and drives it through covers for a couple.
SIX! Clean hit this time from Cleaver! Young bangs it short on off. Cleaver stays still and just pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Back of a length, around off. Guptill looks to defend but gets the inside edge onto his pads. A quick single is taken as the ball rolls away towards the leg side.
Angling into leg. Cleaver looks to switch-hit it but misses.

NOT OUT! George Dockrell bowls a tad short, around off. Cleaver though tries to push it off the front foot. The ball turns away a tad and beats the outside edge of his blade. Tucker collects the ball behind the stumps and whips the bails off. There is an appeal for the stumping and the leg umpire takes it upstairs. However, the replays show that Cleaver has his foot inside the crease. So Dane Cleaver will continue.
Stumping chance! There is an appeal for Stumping against Dane Cleaver! The replays show that his back foot is back in the crease on time. NOT OUT it is!
Darted on middle and leg. Guptill works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and quicker on middle. Guptill blocks it off the front foot.
A flatter one on middle. Cleaver pushes it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Tossed up on middle. Cleaver makes a bit of room and plays a delightful inside-out shot over extra cover for a boundary.
George Dockrell is introduced into the attack.
Cleaver backs away a bit early and Barry McCarthy follows him with a length delivery on leg. Cleaver defends it towards covers and takes a single.
Back of a length, around off. Guptill steers it towards backward point for a single.

In the air...but safe! Just short of good length and angling into the body. Cleaver looks to work it towards the leg side but the ball hits high on his blade. It loops up in the air towards square leg and Andy Balbirnie at mid-wicket runs to his right to catch it but fails to reach it. Single in the end.
Back of a length, on off. Cleaver blocks it from his crease.
This time it jags away to the other side! On a good length and outside off again. Cleaver looks to push at it but the ball nips away and beats the outside edge of his blade this time,
Ohh...lovely delivery! Barry McCarthy serves it on a good length and outside off. Cleaver looks to defend it but the ball seams into him sharply and beats the inside edge of his blade.
Single to end the over! Lands on a length, around off. Cleaver pushes it to sweeper cover and it is another single. Just 4 from the over! New Zealand are 51/1 after the Powerplay!
On the shorter side, around off. Guptill makes some room this time and skips down the track. He slaps it without much timing to covers and takes a single.
Beaten! Back of a length, outside off. Martin Guptill goes for a big swing across the line but misses.
Good bouncer! Bangs it short on off. Martin Guptill initially sets up to pull this one but then lets it go.
Lands on a length, on off at 130 kph. Dane Cleaver just pushes it gently to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Martin Guptill defends it towards the off side and takes a single.
Another short one, outside off. Martin Guptill pushes it off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Dane Cleaver guides it down to third man for a single.
Play and a miss! On a length, shaping away, outside off. Dane Cleaver looks to drive this one but he gets beaten.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Martin Guptill pushes it towards point for a single.
Dane Cleaver is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! A stunning catch from Barry McCarthy to dismiss the dangerous Finn Allen! Much-needed wicket for Ireland! Josh Little draws first blood. He hits the deck hard, serves a short ball, and outside off. Finn Allen looks to pull again, but the ball goes off the splice of the bat and flies high over the bowler's head. Barry McCarthy from mid on runs to his left, dives and takes a terrific catch. A good cameo from Finn Allen comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Barry McCarthy b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR LEG BYES! A short ball, on the thigh pad. Finn Allen swivels and misses his pull. The ball deflects off his thigh pad and goes above short fine leg towards the fence for a boundary.
A length ball, angling in, on the pads. Finn Allen flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, outside off. Finn Allen pushes it towards point off the back foot.
Another shorter ball, around off. Finn Allen once again goes for the pull but he misses the ball hit him on his arms and goes towards point.
FOUR! 14 runs off the first three balls! Shorter one, around off. Finn Allen goes for the pull but the ball goes off the inner half past mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Back of a length, on the hips. Finn Allen flicks it fine towards fine leg for a boundary.
SIX! BOOM! A fuller ball, around middle. Finn Allen tonks it high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Barry McCarthy is into the attack now.
Beaten! This one lands on a length, nips back in, around middle. Martin Guptill gets beaten on the inside edge.
On a length, around middle. Martin Guptill blocks it out.
Finn Allen takes the aerial route again but falls safe! A short ball, outside off. Finn Allen hoicks it towards deep mid-wicket. The ball goes one bounce to the fielder there. Single taken!
FOUR! Up and over! Much fuller now, outside off, slower in pace as well. Finn Allen walks across and drives it aerially over cover for a boundary.
Another play and a miss! On a length, angling away, wide of off. Finn Allen shuffles across and swings hard at it but he misses again. Two dots in a row!
Swing and a miss! A shorter ball, shaping away, outside off. Finn Allen stays in his crease and tries to cut this away but he fails to get any bat on it.
Josh Little is into the attack now after an expensive first over from Craig Young.
Another length delivery, around middle and leg. Finn Allen clips through square leg and takes a single. He retains the strike!
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Martin Guptill tucks it towards square leg for a single.

Tight single! A length ball, outside off. Finn Allen stays in the crease and tries to push this away but he gets an inside edge away from the stumps and towards the leg side. The keeper runs forward and has a shy at the striker's end but he misses.
Angling in, tad fuller, around middle. Martin Guptill works it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Wide! Wide outside off, fuller in length. Martin Guptill leaves it alone. Wide called!
A length ball, outside off. Finn Allen slices this one wide of long off. The fielder runs to his left and cuts it out. Only a single.
Mark Adair begins with a fuller one, outside off. Martin Guptill drives it towards deep cover for a single.
Mark Adair to start from the other end.
FOUR! On a length, around middle. Finn Allen makes room and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Good start from New Zealand! 13 runs off the first over!
A length ball, around middle and leg. Finn Allen flicks it straight to the fielder at square leg. A dot ball!
SIX! BANG! Finn Allen connects it this time! A short ball, around middle. Finn Allen pulls this over Curtis Campher at deep square leg for a biggie!
On a length, angling in, around middle and leg. Finn Allen looks to flick this but he gets a slight inside edge back onto his pads.
In the air...and just short! Back of a length, outside off. Finn Allen goes for the pull shot but the ball goes off the top edge and lands short of Curtis Campher at deep square leg. Two taken!
Craig Young begins with a length ball, darting it on the hips. Martin Guptill tucks it through square leg for a single. New Zealand and Martin Guptill are up and running!

We are moments away from the start of this second T20I! The Ireland players make their way out to the middle, they need to get their act right today if they want to level this series. Finn Allen and Martin Guptill are the two dangerous Kiwi openers. Craig Young to start with the ball for Ireland. Martin Guptill will take the strike. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Isobel Joyce is pitchside. She says that it's the same pitch on which the first game was played but that's all that is the same, conditions are overcast and much cooler this time. Mentions that there is an even covering of grass with a few cracks. Adds that the bowlers will have to bowl in the right areas. Further adds that the captain winning the toss should bat first since chasing is tough on this ground

Mitchell Santner, the skipper of New Zealand says that he is pretty happy with the performance in the last game and they were under the pump with the bat initially but Glenn Phillips and James Neesham batted well and then the bowlers did the job. Tells that the wicket looks a two-paced and the boundaries are bit large here so that helps. Says that he is enjoying the captaincy role and it is a young group and they are looking forward to doing well in this game. Informs that they are playing the same XI.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland, says that they will bowl again, the wicket looks much better. Adds that 150 was a par score in the previous game and it looks more or less the same. Mentions that they did not have a good Powerplay with the bat but he is still pleased with how everyone performed in the game but they want to put on a better show with the bat. Further adds that they are focusing on putting good performances and he hopes they can get over the line in this game. Informs that they are playing the same team.

Ireland (Unchanged Playing XI) - Andy Balbirnie (C), Paul Stirling, Gareth Delany, Harry Tector, Curtis Campher, George Dockrell, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Mark Adair, Barry McCarthy, Craig Young, Josh Little.

New Zealand (Unchanged Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Finn Allen, Dane Cleaver (WK), Glenn Phillips, Daryl Mitchell, James Neesham, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner (C), Ish Sodhi, Lockie Ferguson, Jacob Duffy.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Andy Balbirnie. Ireland have elected to BOWL first.

The pitch was not the best for the batters in the previous game. The wicket was quite sticky and sluggish. Will it be the same in this game as well? We will find out. Stay tuned for the vital toss and other updates.
